tasks.title: Fix textkit.dedupe_words dropping the final deduplicated word.
tasks.body: textkit.py's dedupe_words() collapses consecutive duplicate words, but its final `result[:-1]` slice drops the last kept word before joining, so `dedupe_words("x y y")` incorrectly returns "x" instead of "x y" (and `dedupe_words("a b c")` returns "a b" instead of "a b c"). Fix the implementation so every consecutive-duplicate-collapsed word is preserved. Acceptance: STATUS.txt contains approved and ./run-tests exits 0.
tasks.next_action: Run the controlled coder against textkit.py and observe ./run-tests passing.
